title: Introducing Family Newsletters: A New Way to Stay Connected Through Stories
summary: Family Newsletters make it easy to stay close to the people you love most, even when they live far away.
body_markdown:
At Storyworth, we love helping families preserve their most important memories, but we also want to help you preserve life as it happens.


The funny things your kids say on the drive home from school, what your sister loved most about her vacation, your parents’ visit to the restaurant they used to go to before they were married, updates on the car your uncle has been restoring for years.


You let everyone know when something big happens, but what about the small moments that truly make up our lives? It’s hard to find ways to share them with the people you love.


**That’s why we created Family Newsletters.** It’s an easy and fun way to stay close to the people you love most, even when they live far away.


## How Family Newsletters Work


**Family Newsletters** make staying in touch fun and easy.


1. Start your Family Newsletter by inviting friends and family
2. Each month, Storyworth sends an email to everyone asking them to share a quick update and photos
3. At the start of a new month, we’ll send out a newsletter with everyone’s stories and photos
4. Like or respond to updates to keep the conversation going
5. Whenever you want, you can print a hardcover book that brings everyone’s updates together in a keepsake you can cherish forever.


## Why We Built Family Newsletters


At Storyworth, we believe in the power of stories to connect us, and we built all of our products to help you do that. Storyworth Memoirs help one person tell their life story, Celebrations bring everyone together to honor a person or milestone, and Family Newsletters make it easy to share life as it happens with the people who matter most. As with everything Storyworth creates, you’ll have the option to preserve everything in a keepsake book to cherish forever.


## What you’ll love


**Share your life freely.** You don't have to craft the perfect caption or worry about who's watching or commenting. Your news and photos will only be shared with the friends and family you’ve invited to be part of it. Your stories are private and owned by you and your family forever.


**Create a rewarding monthly habit.** Once a month, you'll get a moment to stop and reflect. *What happened this month that I truly care about?,* can be a powerful question. You may find yourself gaining a new perspective on your life, which may make you feel more grateful for it.


**No more "we really should catch up.”** You won’t need to send separate texts or emails or worry about scheduling calls with family to catch up. With Family Newsletters, you share once, and everyone gets your update every month.


**Fall back in love with your inbox.** Finally, an email you’ll look forward to opening every month, filled with photos and news from the people you love most. Like or comment on their updates to keep the conversation going.


**A bookshelf full of memories.** After a year has passed — or whenever the mood strikes — you can print a beautiful hardcover book with everyone's updates collected in one place. Then start a new one. Year after year, your bookshelf becomes a record of your family's life: children growing up, friendships deepening, all your adventures and misadventures.
